phase_prompt.label: Default Manifestation
phase_prompt.summary: The Spirit hovers as a stable, luminous projection of atmospheric code, interfacing with the environment.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A hyper-realistic medium shot of the Spirit of the Sky, a glowing, intangible humanoid form composed of blue data particles and vertical light streaks. The figure is translucent, revealing the dark, geometric structure of the sky dome behind it. Its face is a smooth pane of dark data glass reflecting the scene. The atmosphere is cold and digital, with a sharp focus on the texture of the light particles. Rendered in Octane with a 50mm lens, ISO 100, cinematic color grading.
